chapter: Maple Leaf, own orchestra and rivals
title: The Eagle band's drawing power and lineup
summary: They recall the Eagle band (Dusen, Oliver, Johnny Brown, Baby Dodds) drawing a crowd to a cleaned-out stable.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel

blocks.x: I don't know what happened to Caden, but oh, but that guy was rough.
He could play that instrument though. You could hear him by from here to the bridge over there.
Do you know what he did?

He came right there in the eye barrier there and they cleaned his stable. You see that right next door to that station there was a stable there? Yes. You remember they used to have a stable? Yeah, I sure did. And you know they cleaned that stable out. They didn't want to give them no place so they couldn't walk, you know? And so they cleaned that stable out and the people gave it down in that stable. And the people left all the rest of the place, come right down in that stable.
That's right. And played like I told you, that was the other band that I was telling you about that didn't play a note in music. Just that rough stuff.
No, that was Frankie Dusen, Eagle. Oh, the Eagle band.

Who was in the Eagle band? Frankie Dusen? King Oliver? King Oliver? How do you call him? That fellow again? Oh, I was shocked. As good as I knew him. Because Frankie was playing trombone you see, and King Oliver playing trumpet. And this guy? Johnny, you remember Johnny? Johnny? What did he play? Bass. Johnny Brown. Don't you remember Johnny Brown? I never knew him. Oh, that guy could play that bass. My dear Oh yes, they had a good line up. When they could come there and clean a stable and draw all the people, you know they must have a good line up.
Did they have a good drummer, a good banjo player, a guitar player? Who was playing drums?
Baby Dot. Oh yeah. You remember Baby Dot went to Chicago, he died there not long ago. Yes.

Oh yeah. Let's see. Did you know that nasty talking guitar player? Who? That nasty talking guitar player, Lorenzo Stahl. Did you know him, the one who would sing all the dirty songs? No. I thought he played with Eagle for a while.
